purpose: Collect newsletter signups on a marketing page using local block styling rather than global form theme changes.
audience: Website visitors on a campaign or homepage section
source_template: Newsletter signup with per-block style guidance

fields.label: First name
fields.accessibility_notes: Visible label retained unless an accessible project pattern exists.

fields.label: Email address
fields.accessibility_notes: Visible label and clear validation message required.

fields.label: Marketing consent
fields.privacy_notes: Consent wording must be approved and retained for audit evidence.

field_settings.layout: single column by default; compact only after responsive validation
field_settings.style_scope: per Gravity Forms block, not global

confirmations.name: Signup confirmation
confirmations.message: Thanks. Please check your inbox for the next step.

spam_settings.turnstile: use only if available and visually validated in the embed container

accessibility_settings.focus: visible focus state must survive block styling
accessibility_settings.errors: required email and consent errors must remain readable

embedding_target.style_strategy: local block Form Styles; no global theme change

data_retention_notes: Retain only signup evidence needed for email marketing operations and consent proof.
required_addons: Email marketing add-on only if list sync is required
risks: Global form theme changes could affect unrelated forms
Compact styling can hide labels, errors, or CAPTCHA widgets if not tested on mobile
